# Theme Token — Technical Reference

Theme Token is a BSV application and data format for publishing ShadCN-compatible
themes as 1Sat Ordinals. The Theme Token JSON document is the durable content;
themetoken.dev is the validation, preview, discovery, and ShadCN registry gateway.

## URLs

- Specification: https://themetoken.dev/spec
- JSON Schema: https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json
- Theme Studio: https://themetoken.dev/studio/theme
- Registry item: https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin]
- Raw 1Sat content: https://api.1sat.app/content/[origin]
- SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@theme-token/sdk

Both suffixless registry URLs and `.json` URLs work. The suffixless form is
canonical:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin]
```

## Theme Token v1 document

Root requirements:

- `$schema`: exactly `https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json`
- `name`: non-empty theme name
- `styles.light` and `styles.dark`: style maps

`author`, `css`, `bundle`, and `generation` are optional.

Each style map requires these 19 semantic colors:

- `background`, `foreground`
- `card`, `card-foreground`
- `popover`, `popover-foreground`
- `primary`, `primary-foreground`
- `secondary`, `secondary-foreground`
- `muted`, `muted-foreground`
- `accent`, `accent-foreground`
- `destructive`, `destructive-foreground`
- `border`, `input`, `ring`

Each style map also requires `radius`. Additional string-valued CSS variables are
allowed. Common optional variables include `chart-1` through `chart-5`, sidebar
colors, font families, letter spacing, spacing, shadows, and background images.
Colors normally use direct CSS OKLCH values such as `oklch(0.55 0.22 255)`.

## Optional assets and provenance

On-chain assets can be referenced with `/content/[origin]` in font or image
properties. A theme bundle may list sibling outputs:

```json
{
  "bundle": {
    "version": 1,
    "assets": [{ "vout": 0, "type": "font", "slot": "sans" }]
  }
}
```

AI generation metadata is optional:

```json
{
  "generation": {
    "prompt": "required when generation is present",
    "provider": "optional",
    "model": "optional",
    "timestamp": 1770000000000
  }
}
```

## Storage and discovery

New themes are `ord-fs/json` directory packages containing `theme.json`. MAP
metadata is attached to the directory manifest, not duplicated inside the theme:

```json
{
  "app": "theme-token",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "name": "Theme Name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "ShadCN theme: Theme Name"
}
```

Current registry mappings:

| Asset | MAP `type` | Package content |
|---|---|---|
| Theme | `registry:style` | `theme.json` |
| Font | `registry:font` | font file |
| Pattern, wallpaper, icon | `registry:file` | image/SVG file |
| Project preset | `registry:base` | `project.json` |

All MAP records require `app`, `type`, `name`, `version`, and `description`.
`author`, `license`, `prompt`, `provider`, and `model` are optional metadata.

## Registry response

`GET /r/themes/[origin]` fetches `[origin]/theme.json`, validates it, and returns
the current ShadCN registry item shape:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "theme-name",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "css": {},
  "cssVars": {
    "theme": { "radius": "0.625rem" },
    "light": { "background": "oklch(1 0 0)" },
    "dark": { "background": "oklch(0.145 0 0)" }
  }
}
```

OKLCH values are preserved. Tailwind CSS v4 consumes the ShadCN registry item;
consumers should not wrap these already-complete values in another `oklch()`.

## SDK

```ts
import {
  applyTheme,
  fetchThemeByOrigin,
  parseCss,
  toShadcnRegistry,
  validateThemeToken,
} from "@theme-token/sdk";
```

- `validateThemeToken(data)` validates a Theme Token document.
- `parseCss(css, name)` parses `:root` and `.dark` variables and validates the
  complete result.
- `fetchThemeByOrigin(origin)` loads packaged themes with a legacy direct-content
  fallback.
- `toShadcnRegistry(theme)` emits `registry:style`.
- `applyTheme(theme)` applies variables in a browser.

## Project presets

Project packages contain `project.json` and use MAP type `registry:base`.
They are served through:

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest create --preset "https://themetoken.dev/init?project=[origin]" --template next
```

## Scope

The JSON format can be copied to other storage systems, but themetoken.dev
publishing, discovery, ownership, marketplace, and gateway behavior currently
target BSV 1Sat Ordinals only. Other-chain examples are not part of this spec.

On-chain data is durable, but friendly registry, preview, and optimized-media URLs
depend on gateway infrastructure. Consumers that need independent verification
can fetch the content by origin from compatible 1Sat infrastructure.
